profiles.summaryZh: 先获得清晰的任务状态和费用反馈，尽量少装、容易理解。
profiles.summaryEn: Start with visible task status and cost feedback without installing too much.

profiles.summaryZh: 让 Harness 更安全地理解 Git 工作区，并在失败时给出可操作诊断。
profiles.summaryEn: Give Harness safe Git context and actionable diagnostics when a run fails.

profiles.summaryZh: 关注供应商连通性、延迟、错误分类和并发状态。
profiles.summaryEn: Focus on provider connectivity, latency, failure categories, and concurrency.

profiles.summaryZh: 查看费用、Token、额度和并发，减少超预算或触发限流的意外。
profiles.summaryEn: Track cost, tokens, quota, and concurrency to avoid budget and rate-limit surprises.

profiles.summaryZh: 更直观地知道任务是否仍在运行、是否等待输入以及何时完成。
profiles.summaryEn: See whether work is active, waiting for input, or complete at a glance.

profiles.summaryZh: 查看全部已验证插件；仍建议按需安装。
profiles.summaryEn: Review every verified plugin, while still installing only what you need.

plugins.name: dsh-billing
plugins.descriptionZh: 按 provider/model 显示费用、Token、会话额度和输入区费用进度。
plugins.descriptionEn: Shows cost, tokens, session quota, and composer progress by provider and model.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合希望看清每轮成本、及时发现未定价模型的用户。
plugins.reasonEn: Useful for understanding per-turn cost and finding unpriced models.
plugins.privacy: 本地只读统计 / local read-only accounting
plugins.network: 不新增网络请求 / no added network requests

plugins.name: dsh-error-lens
plugins.descriptionZh: 提供只读、脱敏的供应商错误分类和处理建议。
plugins.descriptionEn: Provides read-only, redacted provider failure categories and guidance.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合编程和 API 调试，能把模糊失败整理成可执行建议。
plugins.reasonEn: Turns vague coding and API failures into actionable guidance.
plugins.privacy: 错误信息脱敏 / redacted diagnostics
plugins.network: 不新增网络请求 / no added network requests

plugins.name: dsh-concurrency-meter
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读显示活动请求、峰值并发、结果和供应商分组。
plugins.descriptionEn: Shows active requests, peak concurrency, results, and provider groups read-only.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合并行或长任务，可快速判断是否仍在运行或接近限流。
plugins.reasonEn: Helps long or parallel work reveal activity and possible rate-limit pressure.
plugins.privacy: 仅状态与计数 / status and counts only
plugins.network: 不新增网络请求 / no added network requests

plugins.name: dsh-provider-probe
plugins.descriptionZh: 由用户手动触发供应商连通性、延迟和能力检查。
plugins.descriptionEn: Runs explicit provider connectivity, latency, and capability checks.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合 API 调试；只有点击检查时才会访问所选供应商。
plugins.reasonEn: Built for API debugging and contacts a provider only after an explicit check.
plugins.privacy: 不读取密钥值 / never reads secret values
plugins.network: 仅手动检查时 / only during manual checks

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-git-inspect
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Agent 提供只读 Git 状态、diff、历史、提交和 refs 工具。
plugins.descriptionEn: Provides read-only Git status, diff, history, commit, and refs tools.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合日常编程，不执行提交、推送、切换分支或修改文件。
plugins.reasonEn: Designed for daily coding without commits, pushes, branch switches, or file changes.
plugins.privacy: 只读 Git 输出 / read-only Git output
plugins.network: 不访问远程仓库 / no remote repository access

plugins.name: dsh-companion
plugins.descriptionZh: 蓝色鲸鱼男孩桌面伙伴，用动作和气泡显示任务状态。
plugins.descriptionEn: A blue whale-boy companion that communicates task state with motion and bubbles.
plugins.reasonZh: 适合新手和长任务，能直观看到思考、工具、等待、完成与错误。
plugins.reasonEn: Makes thinking, tools, waiting, completion, and errors visible for new and long-running work.
plugins.privacy: 不读提示词或回复 / no prompts or responses
plugins.network: 不新增网络请求 / no added network requests
